extension.description: Live Streaming, the last week of replays, All Films, Documentaries, On-Demand programs and Search, from la7play.it
Diretta Live, Rivedi ultima settimana, Tutti i Film, Documentari, Programmi On-Demand e Ricerca, da la7play.it
extension.news:
8.0.0 (2026-11-02) - The add-on reads la7play.it, the site LA7 moved to: listings come from its API and its page data, not from scraped markup - Sections: LA7 and LA7 Cinema Live, Replay of the last week, Film, Documentari, Programmi, Search - A program page opens the categories it publishes; a category opens its archive, newest first - Search is the site's search, 20 results per page, and the query survives playback - Playback reads the player data of the page: clear HLS, or DASH with the Conax license; live is two fixed manifests - News and Weather, Teche LA7, Personalities and LA7 Eventi are gone: the site no longer publishes them - beautifulsoup4 is no longer required - One dialog and one log line per failure, naming the section that failed
7.1.0 (2026-10-08) - Added Search function - Fix Personalities biography - LA7 Meteo replaced with Omnibus Meteo in the News and Weather section
7.0.0 (2025-10-23) - LA7d channel replaced with the new LA7 Cinema - New channel LA7 Eventi - Review function of the new LA7 Cinema channel - Added Tutti i Film page in the La7 Prime section - TG La7d replaced with TG Digital in the News and Weather section - Omnibus News replaced with Edicola in the News and Weather section - Protagonist section replaced with Personalities section
